items.title: Bangladesh emerging team bowled out for 89 in heavy defeat to SA
items.summary: dured a disappointing start to the one-day tri-series in South Africa, slumping to a seven-wicket defeat against South Africa Emerging at Groenkloof Oval in Pretoria on Saturday.

items.title: Litton Das added to Bangladesh Test squad for series against Australia
items.summary: Batter has recovered from calf injury that sidelined him from Bangladesh's fixtures in July

items.title: Injury-hit Tigers receive Litton boost ahead of Australia Tests
items.summary: Litton is scheduled to fly to Darwin on Sunday to join the rest of the squad.

items.title: SENA struggles an ominous sign
items.summary: Grass-covered pitches, steep bounce, persistent seam movement and unfamiliar conditions have often made life difficult for visiting Asian sides, with Bangladesh enduring one of the toughest struggles.

items.title: Underprepared and into the unknown
items.summary: The challenge in Australia was never going to be easy. Yet, after months of knowing what lay ahead, Bangladesh leave for the unknown with preparation emerging as the focal talking point.

items.title: Shanto: Bangladesh fast bowlers will 'give Australia a tough time'
items.summary: Shanto also welcomed Australia's decision to field a full-strength squad, seeing it as a sign of the "respect" Bangladesh have earned

items.title: Hazlewood: I'd love to play more with Scotty Boland
items.summary: Hazlewood has changed his preparation heading towards the series against Bangladesh having missed eight of Australia's last 14 Tests through injury

items.title: Litton Das named Bangladesh's new ODI captain
items.summary: He takes over from Mehidy, who the BCB hopes will be able to regain top form without added responsibility
